**Our Development Process **

## **How We Build Software **

A proven seven-step engineering process that keeps every project transparent, predictable, and built for long-term growth.

**STEP 01**

### **Discovery**

We learn about your business, challenges, and objectives to ensure every solution begins with a clear understanding.

- Business Goals
- Project Scope
- Requirements

**STEP 02**

### **Planning**

Requirements are transformed into a practical roadmap with clear milestones, timelines, and technical decisions.

- Roadmap
- Architecture
- Timeline

**STEP 03**

### **Design**

User-centered interfaces and experiences are designed before development begins.

- Wireframes
- UI Design
- Prototype

**STEP 04**

### **Development**

Our engineers build reliable, secure, and scalable software using modern technologies and best practices.

- Backend
- Frontend
- API Integration

**STEP 05**

### **Testing**

Every feature undergoes comprehensive testing to ensure quality, security, and performance.

- QA
- Performance
- Security

**STEP 06**

### **Deployment**

Your solution is deployed using automated pipelines and industry best practices.

- Production
- Monitoring
- Launch

**STEP 07**

### **Continuous Support**

We continue improving your solution through maintenance, updates, and future enhancements.

- Maintenance
- Updates
- Growth

**What We Do**

# **Technology that moves your business forward.**

From custom software and digital products to cloud infrastructure and IT systems, we help businesses turn technology challenges into practical solutions.

**More than technology services **

## **We build technology around real business needs. **

Every organisation has different goals, processes, and challenges. The right technology should reflect that, not force your business into a one-size-fits-all approach.

At Softview Ghana, we combine software development, product thinking, design, and infrastructure expertise to help organisations build, improve, and manage their technology.

Whether you are starting with an idea, modernising an existing system, or improving your IT environment, we work towards a solution that makes practical sense.

[**Tell us what you need **](https://softviewghana.com/contact)

**An integrated approach **

## **Different capabilities. One bigger picture. **

Technology projects rarely exist in isolation. A business application may need a thoughtful interface, reliable hosting, and a secure network environment to work effectively.

Our capabilities allow us to consider these connected needs and approach projects with the bigger picture in mind.

### **Connected solutions**

We consider how software, applications, and infrastructure work together rather than treating every technology decision in isolation.

### **Practical problem-solving**

Our focus is on understanding the actual problem and choosing technology that serves a clear purpose.

### **Products of our own**

Alongside client projects, we develop our own digital products, bringing a product-building perspective to the work we do.

**How we work **

## **From understanding to implementation. **

Every project is different, but our approach starts with understanding the problem and finding the right way to solve it.

**01**

### **Understand the problem**

We learn about your organisation, goals, users, and existing challenges before recommending a solution.

**02**

### **Define the right approach**

We identify the requirements, explore possible solutions, and establish a practical direction for the project.

**03**

### **Design & build**

We turn the agreed solution into a working product or infrastructure, with attention to usability and quality.

**04**

### **Deliver & improve**

We prepare the solution for use and can continue supporting improvements as your needs evolve.

**About Softview Ghana**

# **Technology built with purpose**

We build thoughtful software, digital products and experiences that solve real problems and help businesses and organizations move forward.

**SOFTVIEW GHANA**

Software · Digital Products · Technology

**Our story **

A practical approach to technology, shaped by real-world problems.

## **Technology should make **things better.

Businesses are increasingly dependent on technology, yet technology itself can sometimes become a source of unnecessary complexity.

Softview Ghana is built around a simple idea: create technology that is useful, thoughtfully designed and genuinely suited to the people and organizations using it.

That means looking beyond simply delivering software. We take time to understand the problem, the people involved and the environment in which a solution needs to work.

From websites and business systems to products of our own, we approach every project with the same attention to detail: build something that works today and has room to grow tomorrow.

**What guides us **

## **Principles behind **the work.

The quality of technology is not only measured by what it can do, but also by the thought and care that go into creating it.

01

### **Purpose over noise**

We believe technology should solve a real problem, improve an experience or create a meaningful opportunity. Everything else is noise.

02

### **Built to last**

We care about the foundations as much as the interface. Our solutions are designed with reliability, maintainability and growth in mind.

03

### **Simple is powerful**

Complex problems do not need complicated experiences. We work to make powerful technology feel clear and intuitive.

04

### **People come first**

Technology exists to serve people. We design around the people who use, operate and depend on the systems we build.

**What we do **

Different challenges require different solutions. Our work spans products, software and digital experiences.

01

### **Software Products**

We design and build digital products that solve specific problems and create lasting value for the people who use them.

**SaaS****Platforms****Web applications**

02

### **Custom Software**

We turn unique business requirements into software that fits the way an organization actually works.

**Business systems****Automation****Integrations**

03

### **Digital Experiences**

We create thoughtful digital experiences that help organizations communicate, connect with people and grow.

**Websites****UX / UI****Digital presence**

**Where we build **

## **Built from Ghana. **<br>Designed for what's next.

Ghana is where we build, learn and understand the realities of the businesses and communities we serve. But our ambition is not limited by geography. We believe useful technology can create opportunities wherever people and businesses need it.

**Accra, Ghana**

Our home base

**How we work **

A considered process helps us focus on what matters and deliver solutions with purpose.

## **Good technology starts with **understanding.

01

### **Understand the problem**

Learn about the people, challenges and objectives behind the project.

02

### **Design the right solution**

Translate requirements into a clear and practical direction.

03

### **Build with intention**

Develop the solution with attention to usability and solid foundations.

04

### **Refine through feedback**

Evaluate, improve and make adjustments based on real-world needs.

05

### **Support what we create**

Help solutions remain useful as requirements and business needs evolve.

**Building our own **

## **We don't just build for others. **We build products too.

Working with businesses gives us a close view of the challenges organizations face every day. We also use that perspective to develop our own digital products, exploring better ways to make complex work simpler and more accessible.

[**Explore Softview Ghana **](https://softviewghana.com/)

**Product studio **

**Turning real-world problems into useful digital products. **

Practical thinking. Thoughtful design. Purposeful technology.

**Our Products**

# **Software Products Built to Solve Real Problems**

We don't only build software for clients. We develop and own digital products designed to address practical challenges and create lasting value.

**Product development **

## **Independent products. Purposeful technology. **

Every product starts with a problem worth solving. We focus on understanding the people, processes, and everyday challenges behind that problem, then build software around those needs.

**Featured product **

## **eSchool Ghana **

**The School Operating System for basic schools in Ghana. **

**Planned launch January 2027 **

Running a school involves coordinating students, teachers, academics, finances, communication, and administration. eSchool Ghana is being developed to bring these essential operations together in one connected platform.

### **Product capabilities **

Admissions & Enrollment

Student Information Management

Academic Administration

Attendance Management

Assessments & Examinations

Automatic Report Cards

Fees & Payment Management

Accounting & Financial Administration

Staff & Payroll Administration

SMS, Email & Telegram Communication

Parent & Teacher Portals

Timetables & School Calendar

Reports & Analytics

**Product direction **

### **Built around how schools actually operate. **

The goal is to give school stakeholders a more connected way to manage everyday responsibilities and access the information they need.

#### **One Integrated Platform**

Bring essential school operations together instead of relying on disconnected tools and manual processes.

#### **Better Operational Visibility**

Help school leaders access relevant information across academic, administrative, and financial activities.

#### **Designed Around School Workflows**

Built with the operational realities of private basic schools in Ghana in mind.

#### **Connected School Community**

Support coordination between administrators, teachers, parents, and other school stakeholders.

#### **Room to Grow**

A flexible foundation designed to support schools as their operations and requirements evolve.

**Discover the eSchool Ghana vision. **

Explore the product and its planned capabilities.

[**Visit eSchool Ghana **](https://eschoolghana.com)

**featured product **

## **EPSSP **

**Electronic Payroll & Staff Self-Service Portal **

EPSSP simplifies employee records, payroll processing, statutory deductions, payslips and staff self-service for organisations across Ghana.

Human Resources Payroll Employee Self-Service

###### EPSSP insights

- Centralized employee information
- Structured payroll workflows
- Employee access to relevant information
- Better visibility into staff administration

[**Visit EPSPP **](https://epssp.com)

**Product focus **

### **People, payroll, and administration in one place. **

Employee Information Management

Staff Self-Service

Payroll Administration

Compensation & Allowances

Payroll Processing

Statutory Payroll Processing

Employee Records & Documents

Leave & Staff Administration

Planned areas of functionality. Product scope and availability may evolve during development.

**What guides our products **

## **Useful software starts with understanding the problem. **

We want our products to be practical, dependable, and relevant to the people who use them. These principles guide how we approach product development.

### **People first **

Build around the needs and everyday experiences of real users.

### **Connected workflows **

Bring related activities together instead of adding unnecessary complexity.

### **Responsible design **

Consider security, privacy, and responsible information handling.

### **Continuous improvement **

Evolve products as user needs and operational requirements change.

**Industries**

# **Technology that understands your industry.**

Different industries have different challenges. We take the time to understand how your organisation works and build technology around the processes, people, and goals that matter.

**Industry-aware solutions **

## **Different industries. Different challenges. **

Technology is most effective when it reflects the realities of the people and organisations using it.

A school, retail business, healthcare provider, and professional services firm may all need digital systems, but their workflows, responsibilities, and priorities are not the same.

We approach each project by understanding its operating environment first, then identifying practical ways technology can improve how the organisation works.

[**Discuss your organisation **](https://softviewghana.com/contact)

**Our perspective **

### **Start with the work. Then find the technology. **

We don't assume that every organisation needs the same software, infrastructure, or implementation approach. The right solution begins with understanding the actual problem.

#### **People**

Who uses the system and who benefits from it?

#### **Processes**

How does the organisation get work done?

#### **Priorities**

What needs to improve, and why?

**Our approach **

## **Understand the work before building the solution. **

Industry knowledge matters, but so does understanding the specific organisation. We use a practical approach to move from business challenges to useful technology.

01

### **Understand the industry**

We learn how your organisation operates, the people it serves, and the specific challenges that shape its work.

02

### **Identify opportunities**

03

### **Build around your needs**

**Legal**

# **Privacy Policy**

How Softview Ghana collects, uses, protects, and manages information.

**Last Updated:** August 10, 2026

## **1. Introduction**

Softview Ghana is committed to protecting the privacy of individuals who interact with our website, products, and services. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and safeguard information in connection with our work.

## **2. Information We Collect **

We may collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, organization, and project details when you contact us or request information about our services or products. We may also collect technical information automatically, such as IP address, device details, browser type, page visits, and referral sources.

## **3. How We Use Information **

We use information to respond to inquiries, assess project requirements, provide information about our products and services, improve our website experience, maintain security, and support business operations. We do not use personal information for unrelated marketing purposes without your consent.

## **4. Cookies and Similar Technologies**

We may use cookies and similar technologies to understand website usage, improve performance, and manage basic analytics. You can control cookies through your browser settings, though some features of the site may not work as intended if cookies are disabled.

## **5. Analytics**

We may use analytics tools to collect information about visitor behavior and site performance. This helps us understand which content and pages are useful and improve the user experience without compromising privacy.

## **6. Communications**

If you contact us, we may communicate with you by email, phone, or other appropriate channels to answer your enquiry, share information, and continue project-related discussions. You may opt out of non-essential communications at any time.

## **7. Data Sharing**

We do not sell personal information. We may share information with trusted service providers who help us operate our website and business, such as hosting, analytics, or communication tools, only where necessary and under appropriate confidentiality obligations.

## **8. Data Security**

We take reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## **9. Data Retention**

We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.

## **10. Your Rights**

Depending on applicable law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of personal information. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details below.

## **11. Third-Party Services **

Our website or services may link to third-party resources or use third-party tools that have their own privacy practices. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those external services.

## **12. Children's Privacy**

Our website and services are not directed to children under the age of 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children without appropriate consent or legal basis.

## **13. International Data Transfers**

Information may be processed or stored in locations outside your home jurisdiction. Where required, we will take appropriate safeguards for international data transfers.

## **14. Changes to This Policy **

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any material changes will be posted on this page with the updated date so you can review the latest version.

## **15. Contact Us**

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle personal information, please contact us at hello@softviewghana.com.

**Legal**

# **Terms of Service**

The terms governing the use of Softview Ghana websites, products, and services.

**Last Updated:** August 10, 2026

## **1. Introduction**

These Terms of Service govern your use of Softview Ghana websites, products, and services. By accessing our website or engaging with our services, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our website or services.

## **2. Definitions**

"Company" refers to Softview Ghana. "Services" includes software development, consulting, product work, infrastructure, design, and related professional services. "Client" means any individual or organization that engages the Company for services or purchases access to products.

## **3. Use of Our Website**

You may use our website for lawful informational purposes. You agree not to misuse the site, interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, or use it in any way that violates applicable law.

## **4. Services**

We provide technology consulting, custom software development, product design, cloud, networking, and related digital services. The scope, timeline, deliverables, and fees for each engagement will be defined in writing before work begins.

## **5. Projects and Deliverables**

Deliverables are defined by the agreed project scope, milestones, and communications between the Company and the Client. Changes to scope, timeline, or priority may affect delivery schedules and fees, and will be discussed with the Client before proceeding.

## **6. Client Responsibilities **

Clients are responsible for providing timely information, decisions, content, access, and feedback needed for project progress. Delays caused by incomplete information or missed approvals may affect project milestones.

## **7. Fees and Payments**

Fees and payment terms will be agreed in writing before engaging in a project or service. Any project may require deposits, milestone payments, or final payments depending on the arrangement between the parties.

## **8. Intellectual Property **

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, intellectual property rights in pre-existing materials remain with their respective owners. Custom work created for a Client may be assigned or licensed according to the written agreement for that engagement.

## **9. Third-Party Services **

We may rely on third-party platforms, libraries, hosting providers, or other services to support our work. These services are subject to their own terms and conditions, and the Company is not responsible for their performance or policies.

## **10. Confidentiality**

We will handle confidential information responsibly and use it only for the purposes of the engagement. Information may be shared internally or with trusted partners only as necessary to perform the services.

## **11. Warranties**

We aim to deliver professional and high-quality services based on the agreed scope and standards. However, services are provided as-is and subject to the specific terms of each engagement, and no party should assume any guarantee beyond those explicitly stated in writing.

## **12. Limitation of Liability **

Softview Ghana is not liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising out of or relating to the use of our website or services, except where liability is expressly required by applicable law or the terms of a written agreement.

## **13. Termination**

Either party may terminate an engagement in accordance with the written agreement governing that work. Upon termination, obligations related to confidentiality, fees, and delivered materials may remain in effect.

## **14. Changes to Services **

We may update, modify, or discontinue parts of our website or services at any time. We will communicate significant changes where appropriate, but continued use of our services indicates acceptance of the updated terms.

## **15. Governing Law**

The governing law and jurisdiction applicable to these Terms will be specified here based on Softview Ghana's actual legal structure. This section is pending legal review and should not be relied upon until finalized.

## **16. Contact**

For any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at hello@softviewghana.com.

# **Technology for better-run schools.**

## **Better school operations start with better-connected systems. **

Running a school involves much more than teaching. Admissions, student records, academic administration, attendance, fees, staff coordination, and communication all need to work together.

We approach education technology by understanding these everyday responsibilities and designing systems around the people and processes behind them — including the needs of Ghanaian basic schools.

# **Technology for more connected financial operations.**

We build digital solutions that help finance-focused organizations manage information, coordinate workflows, strengthen operational controls, and make better use of their data.

**Understanding financial operations **

## **When accuracy matters, the systems behind the work matter too. **

Financial organizations and business finance teams work with information that needs to be accurate, accessible, and properly managed. From customer records and document handling to approvals, reporting, and internal processes, every part contributes to how effectively an organization operates.

We approach these challenges by understanding existing workflows and building technology that supports better coordination, information management, and operational visibility.

**Operational priorities **

02

**Traceability**

03

04

### **Design systems & refinement**

Establish reusable patterns and continuously improve existing product experiences.
